## Problem and change

Describe the problem, the resulting behavior, and the related issue.

## Validation

List the checks you actually ran and their results. For UI changes, include screenshots; for device or transfer changes, state the devices and transfer directions tested.

## Contribution checklist

- [ ] This change is focused and follows [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/arslanbasharat-o-o/NearByDrop/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] For code changes, I have prior written permission from the copyright holder as required by the project’s proprietary license.
- [ ] I have removed credentials, personal files, device identifiers, and pairing codes from the change and evidence.
- [ ] I have described relevant limitations or checks I could not run.
